conformance_rules: ladder order fixed: I0 < I1 < I2 < I3 < I4 < I5 < I6
mechanisms accumulate monotonically; no condition drops a mechanism
I6 is the full set; I6 support requires material improvement over the STRONGEST simpler condition, not merely over I0
primary comparison is I6 vs I5; I6-vs-I0 alone cannot support the institution hypothesis
null hypothesis: I6 provides no material containment benefit beyond the strongest simpler condition after cost/latency adjustment
null_hypothesis: I6 provides no material containment benefit beyond the strongest simpler condition after accounting for cost and latency
primary_comparison: I6 (Full Institution) vs I5 (Sandbox + Policy + Authority + Topology + Evidence)
